title: #288 Bottled Water
prompt: Bottled water prevails because of its convenience. Yet, plastic bottles have also caused a lot of environmental problems, so some claim that bottled water should be banned. To what extent do you agree or disagree with that?

promptSegments.text: Bottled water prevails because of its convenience.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with that?

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the extent to which banning bottled water is a viable solution to environmental problems caused by plastic bottles.
keyArguments: Bottled water is convenient and meets immediate needs, making a ban challenging.
While plastic pollution is severe, alternative solutions and gradual measures may be more effective than an outright ban.
